rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.empty: This channel has no rewards yet.

dialog.title: Edit {title}
dialog.description: Changes go to Twitch when you save.
dialog.unmanageable: Another app made this reward, so Twitch only lets that app change it.

hints.title: The name viewers see in the channel points list.
hints.prompt: Viewers see this under the reward on Twitch.
hints.response: What the bot says in chat when someone redeems it. Empty clears it.
hints.cost: How many channel points one redeem costs.
hints.maxPerStream: Most redeems of this reward in one stream. Empty keeps the current limit.
hints.maxPerUserPerStream: Most redeems per viewer in one stream. Empty keeps the current limit.
hints.globalCooldownSeconds: Seconds to wait between any two redeems. Empty keeps the current cooldown.
hints.timerDurationSeconds: Countdown for a timed reward. 0 clears it.
hints.backgroundColor: The reward color on Twitch, as a hex code like #9146FF.
hints.isEnabled: Viewers can redeem it only while it is on.
hints.isPaused: A paused reward stays visible but viewers cannot redeem it.
hints.isUserInputRequired: The viewer types a message with each redeem.

redemptions.title: Pending rewards
redemptions.emptyFilter: No requests are waiting for this reward.
redemptions.rejectDescription: Twitch cancels each request and gives the points back.
redemptions.rejectRefund: Every viewer gets their channel points back.
